name: edusuite
description: EduSuite / Satyadhi Sharma Tech monorepo: desktop app, API and shared code

scripts.stack:up: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.local.yml --env-file infra/.env.local up -d --build
scripts.stack:down: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.local.yml --env-file infra/.env.local down
scripts.stack:logs: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.local.yml --env-file infra/.env.local logs -f --tail=100
